terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: Welcome to Aikoread. Please read these Terms carefully before registering for or using the Service. By creating an account, signing in, or otherwise using the Service, you acknowledge that you have read and agree to be bound by these Terms in full.

acceptance.heading: 1. Acceptance
paras: These Terms of Service (the "Terms") form a binding agreement between you and the operator of Aikoread (the "Platform") regarding your use of the Service.
If you do not agree to any part of these Terms, you must stop registering for or using the Service immediately.

service.heading: 2. Nature of the Service
paras: The Platform provides technical services only, including but not limited to ebook reading, vocabulary study, and AI-assisted learning features.
The Platform is not responsible for the legality, authenticity, accuracy, or completeness of any content that users upload, store, transmit, or otherwise process.

You understand and agree that the Platform, as a technical service provider, does not actively review the legality of user content and assumes no liability for any legal consequences arising from such content.

userContent.heading: 3. User Content and Legal Responsibility
paras: You bear full legal responsibility for all content you upload, import, store, publish, or otherwise provide to the Platform, including but not limited to ebooks, documents, text, images, and other materials.
You represent that your content does not infringe any third party's copyright, trademark, publicity, privacy, or other rights, and does not violate applicable laws.

Any complaint, lawsuit, claim, administrative penalty, or other legal dispute arising from your content is solely your responsibility. You shall fully indemnify the Platform and any third party for losses caused thereby.

platformRights.heading: 4. Platform Rights
paras: The Platform may, based on applicable law, regulatory requirements, rights-holder complaints, or its own reasonable judgment, delete, take down, restrict access to, or otherwise handle content suspected of being illegal, infringing, or in violation of these Terms, without prior notice.
The Platform may warn, restrict features, suspend service, or ban accounts that violate these Terms or applicable law, without prior notice.
Such actions do not constitute an endorsement of the legality of user content and do not relieve you of your legal responsibilities under these Terms.

account.heading: 5. Account Use
paras: You must keep your account credentials secure and are responsible for all activity under your account.
You may not transfer, lend, or otherwise allow others to use your account without the Platform's written permission.

prohibited.heading: 6. Prohibited Conduct
paras: You may not use the Service for any unlawful activity, including but not limited to uploading pirated content, distributing illegal information, infringing others' rights, or interfering with the Platform's operation.
Upon discovery, the Platform may immediately take the measures described in Section 4 and reserves the right to report the matter to authorities and pursue legal remedies.

disclaimer.heading: 7. Disclaimer
paras: To the maximum extent permitted by law, the Platform is not liable for any direct, indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of or inability to use the Service.
The Platform is not responsible for service interruptions or data loss caused by third-party services, network conditions, device compatibility, or other factors beyond its control.

changes.heading: 8. Changes to These Terms
paras: The Platform may revise these Terms as needed. Updated Terms will be posted on this page. Continued use of the Service constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.

contact.heading: 9. Contact
paras: If you have questions about these Terms, contact us via the in-product feedback feature or other contact channels published by the Platform.

Feedback and reports: submit via the in-product Help Center (suggestions, other complaints, copyright, illegal content), or email aikoread@163.com. Upon a qualified copyright/illegal notice, the Platform will remove or take down the content within 24–48 hours and retain the notice, handling records, and timestamps.
